title: Example 140: half-open bisection that answers the empty table first reads past the end, found by the own checker
description: Regression proof of Mica's LookupSwitch#find rewritten half-open with the empty table answered first and the final equality test unguarded, against the closed form, within the scope of strictly sorted tables (a \forall over the array in --unchanged-unless), by the tool's own checker (approach.engine native): expected violation, find(matches=[0], key=1), -1 before and ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException after. The checker took arrays of primitives into its fragment for this example (a cell per index up to --max-array-length); the library's run took 0.16 s. JBMC found the same input in 23 s and 2 GB.
